title: New character and inventory screens
changes: The Character, Inventory and Skills screens share a fixed column of stats on the left: offense, defense, attributes and resistances, showing what a hovered item, point or skill would change.
The inventory shows your hero in the middle with the worn gear around them: hat, armour and shoes on the left, weapon, shield and ranged weapon on the right.
The menu tiles at the bottom right are bigger, with readable key hints.
